UPDATE facts SET valid_until = COALESCE($1::timestamptz, now()), superseded_by = $2 WHERE id = $3 AND valid_until IS NULL AND (CASE trust_tier WHEN 'user_confirmed' THEN 6 WHEN 'operator_curated' THEN 5 WHEN 'tool_observed' THEN 4 WHEN 'agent_written' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'external_untrusted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= (CASE COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('gbrain.write_trust_tier', true), ''), 'unknown') WHEN 'user_confirmed' THEN 6 WHEN 'operator_curated' THEN 5 WHEN 'tool_observed' THEN 4 WHEN 'agent_written' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'external_untrusted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) RETURNING id

default.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT f.id, f.expired_at, $1::text AS e, $2::text AS s, f.dimension, f.value_hash, f.valid_from, f.source FROM facts f WHERE f.source_id = $3 AND f.dimension IS NOT NULL AND f.source_markdown_slug = $4 AND f.expired_at IS NULL), cand AS ( SELECT m.id, m.expired_at, m.e, m.s, m.dimension, m.value_hash, m.valid_from, m.source, 1 AS moving FROM m UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.expired_at, t.entity_slug, t.source_markdown_slug, t.dimension, t.value_hash, t.valid_from, t.source, 0 FROM facts t WHERE t.source_id = $5 AND t.dimension IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m WHERE m.id = t.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m WHERE m.e = t.entity_slug AND m.s = t.source_markdown_slug AND m.dimension = t.dimension AND m.value_hash = t.value_hash AND m.valid_from = t.valid_from)), ranked AS ( SELECT id, row_number() OVER w AS rn, first_value(id) OVER w AS keep FROM cand WHERE e IS NOT NULL AND s IS NOT NULL AND value_hash IS NOT NULL AND valid_from IS NOT NULL WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY e, s, dimension, value_hash, valid_from ORDER BY COALESCE(source, '') LIKE 'cli:extract-conversation-facts%', (expired_at IS NULL) DESC, moving, id)) SELECT id, keep FROM ranked WHERE rn > 1

UPDATE facts SET entity_slug = $1, source_markdown_slug = $2, row_num = facts.row_num + COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(f2.row_num) FROM facts f2 WHERE f2.source_id = $3 AND f2.source_markdown_slug = $4 AND f2.row_num IS NOT NULL ), 0) WHERE source_id = $5 AND source_markdown_slug = $6 AND expired_at IS NULL
